headline: COPPER PRICE RECORD EXPLAINED | America is Hoarding Today’s Metal Before AI Creates Tomorrow’s Shortage
summary: Copper has crossed $14,500 a tonne as US tariff fears pull metal into American warehouses, draining stocks elsewhere, according to the report.
why: Copper is a key industrial metal used in power grids and electrification, so its price and stock levels affect manufacturers globally.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Tariff fears pulling metal into US warehouses have pushed prices to a record above $14,500 a tonne.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Tariff fears are drawing copper into American warehouses, reducing stocks available elsewhere and lifting the price.
